Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://textbooksonline.tn.nic.in/ https://www.tnschools.gov.in/textbooks https://scert.tnschools.gov.in/ https://www.dtnext.in/amp/story/news/tamilnadu/tn-govt-releases-new-books-for-classes-1-to-3. Notes: Official sources could not be read: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in and textbookcorp.tn.gov.in refuse the fetch tool (robots.txt); tnschools.gov.in and scert.tnschools.gov.in are JavaScript apps that return no content to the fetch tool; the sandbox shell has no internet access. All chapter information comes from secondary sites, so every chapter is verified:false. EDITION CHANGE: for 2026-27, Classes 1-3 use NEW textbooks written for Tamil Nadu's revised curriculum (State Education Policy, launched Aug 2025). The Minister released the Term 1 books on 18/19 May 2026 (DT Next, News Today). Term 2 books, also new, were printed in Sept 2026 and handed out when schools reopened on 5 Oct 2026. SCERT trained master trainers on 7-8 Oct 2026 (Rc. No. 2640773/F1/2026, dated 03.10.2026). As of 2026-10-19 no source says whether Term 3 will also be new; it probably will be. The earlier (2019-era, Ennum Ezhuthum-aligned) Term 1-3 books are superseded for 2026-27. ENNUM EZHUTHUM: the mission continues in 2026-27. Weekly teacher log books for Classes 1-3 carry the heading 'Ennum Ezhuthum' and index lessons against the new textbook and a separate Teacher's Handbook (THB). Ennum Ezhuthum lesson plans for 2026-27 also exist for Classes 4-5. DT Next (7 May 2026) reports that the separate Ennum Ezhuthum workbook has been merged into the new Classes 1-3 textbook.
